title: ONEPIXEL
description: A beautiful modpack with vanilla style.
body:
![onepixel.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/NzVjirH6/images/53fca00bcc5e1ed83435d279c78612248cc213e3.png)

🟢 ```Hi everyone, I need testers for a modpack on various PC configurations. I’ll be setting up a Discord server soon for discussion—in both English and Russian. Everyone is welcome to help build the community. You can also ask questions and share your ideas. I think we’ll have a lot of fun together. I’ll be back soon with the new 0.0.6a update and the Discord server! :)```

![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-00AF5C?style=flat&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white) ![Kilt](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kilt-00AF5C?style=flat&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)
A modpack that improves vanilla Minecraft. New graphics without shaders, effects, particles, or sounds. New mobs, animals, dungeons, and biomes. New armor, improved End and Nether dimensions. Increased difficulty and many other improvements. There are a couple of scary mods for variety. Caves have also become more dangerous, with mobs that become more powerful with each block deeper into the cave.

![update.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/NzVjirH6/images/928c209cc622c12fc4234576b3dd155bb157c11f.png)

You can check out the changes in the modpack on my [GitHub](https://github.com/SparkleSavvy/ONEPIXEL).

![season.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/NzVjirH6/images/23ea94409377ce90e26f0232cb4ba3e0299e5ef8.png)
